propositions: A new generator script must auto-generate config-reference.md and security.md from config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory, while leaving docs/config.md entirely unchanged to preserve all its consumers.
The generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner within 8 lines naming the generator command and must be registered in test_generated_surface_markers.py and docs/README.md.
A --check drift-detection mode must return 0 on committed docs and nonzero on stale docs, with newline-normalized comparison to handle CRLF checkouts.

Both generated docs must contain anchors for all required topics: precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure.

The generator must use three concrete inputs: rebar._config_schema, rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY with kind==cfg filtering, and rebar._child_env._ADAPTER_SECRET_NAMES; narrative content comes from a curated template constant, not synthesis.
The drift gate must run under make test with no CI provider dependency and all existing config.md consumers must remain intact and passing.
